title: UiA PhD thesis (University of Agder, extbook)

external.name: UiA thesis project files
external.instructions: Open UiA's Overleaf template 'PhD Thesis Template, University of Agder (UiA) 2026' (https://www.overleaf.com/latex/templates/phd-thesis-template-university-of-agder-uia-2026/gghyfkchxxzw) as a project, fill in header/information.tex, download it with Menu > Download > Source, and unzip it into that folder.
